WINDOW_LOCKED_IN.subject: Route {{route_id}} — hours update
WINDOW_LOCKED_IN.body:
Hi {{driver_name}},

Recent time changes on route {{route_id}} have locked in as the official route times.

Please review and let the office know if you have questions.

Thank you,
Transportation

WINDOW_BID_PENDING.subject: Route {{route_id}} — bid pending (payroll notice)
WINDOW_BID_PENDING.body: Route {{route_id}} (driver: {{driver_name}}, {{driver_email}}) has reached the 30-minute contract threshold and is pending bid. Details attached in the workbook.

OPEN_BID_POSTING.subject: Route {{route_id}} — open for bid (sign-up)
OPEN_BID_POSTING.body:
Drivers,

Route {{route_id}} is posted for bid under Art. 3.08.

To be considered, complete the Microsoft Forms sign-up (name + initials) within two (2) school days — due {{bid_response_due_date}}. Failing to initial by that deadline is a rejection of the open position per Art. 3.08(c)(1).

Thank you,
Transportation

WINDOW_BUMP_ELIGIBLE.subject: Route {{route_id}} — decrease determination / bump option
WINDOW_BUMP_ELIGIBLE.body:
Hi {{driver_name}},

Route {{route_id}} decreased by 30 minutes or more over the review window. Per Art. 3.08, you may use your seniority to bump a less-senior driver, or confirm that you choose to keep your current assignment.

You have two (2) school days from this determination to decide (due {{bump_decision_due_date}}).

Thank you,
Transportation

BID_AWARDED.subject: Route {{route_id}} — bid awarded
BID_AWARDED.body:
Hi {{driver_name}},

You have been awarded route {{route_id}} as the resolution of a pending bid.

Please confirm you received this notice.

Thank you,
Transportation

NEEDS_REVIEW_RESOLVED_CONTRADICTS_LETTER.subject: Route {{route_id}} — correction to prior notice
NEEDS_REVIEW_RESOLVED_CONTRADICTS_LETTER.body:
Hi {{driver_name}},

A prior notice for route {{route_id}} needs a correction. After review, the outcome differs from what was previously communicated.

Please contact Transportation if you have questions about this update.

Thank you,
Transportation

ROUTE_REASSIGNED.subject: Route {{route_id}} — assignment update
ROUTE_REASSIGNED.body:
Hi {{driver_name}},

Route {{route_id}} has been reassigned to you (previous assignment: {{previous_driver_name}}).

Please confirm you received this notice.

Thank you,
Transportation
